Hero.introduce: Hi, I'm Wallop (“Champ”) — a frontend developer at <synapes>Synapes</synapes> and CTO at Ezygroup Innovation. I build scalable, responsive products with <react>React</react>, <nextjs>Next.js</nextjs>, <ts>TypeScript</ts>, <bun>Bun</bun>, and <flutter>Flutter</flutter>. I also work across <django>Django</django>, <node>Node.js</node>, Docker, and CI/CD when a product needs end-to-end ownership. My focus is clean, maintainable code and seamless user experiences. 🎸🌱

About.about: A web developer specializing in Next.js and Flutter, translating product designs into fast, responsive web and mobile interfaces. Experienced with Docker and production-grade delivery, with enough frontend, backend, and DevOps depth to build software that stays stable, maintainable, and efficient.

works.title: Frontend Developer (Freelance)
works.description: Developed frontend components for DeFi investment tools using modern web technologies. SIMPLI is a Thai FinTech startup integrating AI to analyze yield, volatility, and impermanent loss across platforms on Binance Smart Chain, helping users optimize decentralized investment portfolios. The project won 2nd place at the SCB10X DeFi Launchpad Hackathon 2021.
